items.text: For a long time. <break time="0.8s" /> A terrible disease called the Red Death. <break time="0.8s" /> Had swept across the country. <break time="0.8s" /> And no plague had ever been so deadly. <break time="0.8s" /> Its mark was red. <break time="0.8s" /> For scarlet spots on the face showed. <break time="0.8s" /> That a person had caught it. <break time="0.8s" /> The whole illness. <break time="0.8s" /> From the first signs to the end. <break time="0.8s" /> Took only half an hour. <break time="0.8s" /> And no one could help the sick. <break time="0.8s" /> But Prince Prospero. <break time="0.8s" /> The ruler of the land. <break time="0.8s" /> Was happy and fearless. <break time="0.8s" /> And he was also clever. <break time="0.8s" /> In his own way. <break time="0.8s" /> When half of his people had died. <break time="0.8s" /> He invited a thousand healthy, cheerful friends. <break time="0.8s" /> From among his knights and ladies. <break time="0.8s" /> With them. <break time="0.8s" /> He went away to one of his castles. <break time="0.8s" /> A huge and magnificent building. <break time="0.8s" /> Surrounded by a strong, high wall. <break time="0.8s" /> The gates were made of iron. <break time="0.8s" /> And the courtiers sealed the bolts. <break time="0.8s" /> With fire and heavy hammers. <break time="0.8s" /> So that no one could get in or out. <break time="0.8s" /> There was plenty of food inside. <break time="0.8s" /> And the prince believed. <break time="0.8s" /> That the world outside could take care of itself. <break time="0.8s" /> He had brought clowns, dancers, musicians. <break time="0.8s" /> Beauty, and wine. <break time="0.8s" /> And it seemed foolish. <break time="0.8s" /> To feel sad or even to think. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the walls there was safety. <break time="0.8s" /> But outside them was the Red Death.

For a long time, a terrible disease called the Red Death had swept across the country, and no plague had ever been so deadly. <break time="0.8s" /> Its mark was red, for scarlet spots on the face showed that a person had caught it. <break time="0.8s" /> The whole illness, from the first signs to the end, took only half an hour, and no one could help the sick. <break time="0.8s" /> But Prince Prospero, the ruler of the land, was happy and fearless, and he was also clever in his own way. <break time="0.8s" /> When half of his people had died, he invited a thousand healthy, cheerful friends from among his knights and ladies. <break time="0.8s" /> With them he went away to one of his castles, a huge and magnificent building surrounded by a strong, high wall. <break time="0.8s" /> The gates were made of iron, and the courtiers sealed the bolts with fire and heavy hammers so that no one could get in or out. <break time="0.8s" /> There was plenty of food inside, and the prince believed that the world outside could take care of itself. <break time="0.8s" /> He had brought clowns, dancers, musicians, beauty, and wine, and it seemed foolish to feel sad or even to think. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the walls there was safety, but outside them was the Red Death.

오랫동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 붉은 죽음이라는 무서운 병이. <break time="0.8s" /> 온 나라를 휩쓸어 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그토록 치명적인 전염병은 일찍이 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 병의 표시는 붉은색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 얼굴의 진홍색 반점이 보여 주었기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 사람이 병에 걸렸다는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 병의 전 과정은. <break time="0.8s" /> 첫 증상부터 끝까지. <break time="0.8s" /> 겨우 30분밖에 걸리지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아무도 환자를 도울 수 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러나 프로스페로 공은. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 나라의 통치자인. <break time="0.8s" /> 행복하고 두려움이 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 영리하기도 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 나름대로. <break time="0.8s" /> 백성의 절반이 죽자. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 건강하고 쾌활한 친구 천 명을 불렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 기사와 귀부인들 가운데서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들과 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 자기 성 가운데 하나로 떠났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳은 거대하고 웅장한 건물로. <break time="0.8s" /> 튼튼하고 높은 성벽에 둘러싸여 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 성문은 쇠로 되어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 신하들은 빗장을 녹여 붙였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 불과 무거운 망치로. <break time="0.8s" /> 아무도 드나들 수 없도록. <break time="0.8s" /> 안에는 음식이 넉넉했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 공은 믿었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 바깥세상은 알아서 하면 된다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 광대와 무용수와 악사들을 데려왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아름다움과 포도주도. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러니 어리석어 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 슬퍼하거나 생각하는 것조차. <break time="0.8s" /> 성벽 안에는 안전이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 성벽 밖에는 붉은 죽음이 있었다.

Toward the end of the fifth or sixth month, while the plague raged most fiercely outside, the prince gave a masked ball for his thousand friends. <break time="0.8s" /> It was a splendid party, but first let me tell you about the seven rooms in which it was held. <break time="0.8s" /> In most palaces such rooms form a long, straight line, but here a guest could see little more than one room at a time. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a sharp turn every twenty or thirty yards, and at each turn a new and strange view appeared. <break time="0.8s" /> Each room had tall windows of colored glass, and the color of the glass matched the decorations of the room. <break time="0.8s" /> The first room, at the eastern end, was blue, and the others were purple, green, orange, white, and violet. <break time="0.8s" /> There were no lamps in the rooms, but a brazier, a large metal bowl of fire, burned in the hallway behind each window. <break time="0.8s" /> The seventh room, at the far western end, was covered in black velvet, but its windows were a deep red, the color of blood. <break time="0.8s" /> The firelight shining through the red glass looked so ghostly that few guests were brave enough to step inside. <break time="0.8s" /> It was in this black room that a gigantic clock of ebony stood against the western wall.

다섯째나 여섯째 달이 끝나 갈 무렵. <break time="0.8s" /> 바깥에서 전염병이 가장 맹렬하게 날뛰는 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 공은 가면무도회를 열었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 천 명의 친구들을 위해. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 화려한 파티였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 먼저 이야기하겠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 일곱 개의 방에 대해. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 파티가 열린. <break time="0.8s" /> 대부분의 궁전에서는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런 방들이 길고 곧은 한 줄을 이룬다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 이곳에서는 손님이 볼 수 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한 번에 겨우 방 하나 정도만. <break time="0.8s" /> 급하게 꺾이는 곳이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 20야드나 30야드마다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 꺾일 때마다. <break time="0.8s" /> 새롭고 낯선 광경이 나타났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 방마다 높은 창이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 색유리로 된. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 유리의 색은. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 방의 장식과 어울렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 동쪽 끝에 있는 첫째 방은. <break time="0.8s" /> 파란색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나머지 방들은 자주색, 초록색. <break time="0.8s" /> 주황색, 흰색, 보라색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 방 안에는 등불이 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 화로가. <break time="0.8s" /> 커다란 쇠 불그릇인. <break time="0.8s" /> 복도에서 타올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 창마다 그 뒤에 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 일곱째 방은. <break time="0.8s" /> 맨 서쪽 끝에 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 검은 벨벳으로 덮여 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그 방의 창은 짙은 빨간색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 바로 피의 색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 빨간 유리를 통해 비치는 불빛이. <break time="0.8s" /> 너무나 섬뜩해 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 용감한 손님은 거의 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 안에 발을 들여놓을 만큼. <break time="0.8s" /> 바로 이 검은 방에. <break time="0.8s" /> 거대한 흑단 시계가. <break time="0.8s" /> 서쪽 벽에 기대어 서 있었다.

Its pendulum swung back and forth. <break time="0.8s" /> With a dull, heavy sound. <break time="0.8s" /> And every hour. <break time="0.8s" /> The clock struck with a deep, strange note. <break time="0.8s" /> The sound was so loud and peculiar. <break time="0.8s" /> That the musicians had to stop playing. <break time="0.8s" /> And the dancers stopped dancing. <break time="0.8s" /> For a moment. <break time="0.8s" /> The whole merry crowd was troubled. <break time="0.8s" /> And even the wildest guests turned pale. <break time="0.8s" /> The older guests passed their hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Over their foreheads. <break time="0.8s" /> As if they were lost. <break time="0.8s" /> In a confused dream. <break time="0.8s" /> When the echoes died away. <break time="0.8s" /> Light laughter spread through the rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> And the musicians smiled. <break time="0.8s" /> At their own nervousness. <break time="0.8s" /> They whispered promises. <break time="0.8s" /> That they would not be so troubled. <break time="0.8s" /> The next time the clock struck. <break time="0.8s" /> But after sixty minutes. <break time="0.8s" /> Or three thousand six hundred seconds. <break time="0.8s" /> The clock struck again. <break time="0.8s" /> And everyone was troubled. <break time="0.8s" /> Just as before. <break time="0.8s" /> Still it was a lively party. <break time="0.8s" /> For the prince loved bright colors. <break time="0.8s" /> And strange effects. <break time="0.8s" /> And he had planned every decoration himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Some people would have thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was mad. <break time="0.8s" /> But his followers felt sure. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was not. <break time="0.8s" /> The guests wore wild costumes. <break time="0.8s" /> And moved through the seven rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> Like figures in a dream. <break time="0.8s" /> Until the clock struck once more.

Its pendulum swung back and forth with a dull, heavy sound, and every hour the clock struck with a deep, strange note. <break time="0.8s" /> The sound was so loud and peculiar that the musicians had to stop playing, and the dancers stopped dancing. <break time="0.8s" /> For a moment the whole merry crowd was troubled, and even the wildest guests turned pale. <break time="0.8s" /> The older guests passed their hands over their foreheads as if they were lost in a confused dream. <break time="0.8s" /> When the echoes died away, light laughter spread through the rooms, and the musicians smiled at their own nervousness. <break time="0.8s" /> They whispered promises that they would not be so troubled the next time the clock struck. <break time="0.8s" /> But after sixty minutes, or three thousand six hundred seconds, the clock struck again, and everyone was troubled just as before. <break time="0.8s" /> Still, it was a lively party, for the prince loved bright colors and strange effects, and he had planned every decoration himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Some people would have thought that he was mad, but his followers felt sure that he was not. <break time="0.8s" /> The guests wore wild costumes and moved through the seven rooms like figures in a dream, until the clock struck once more.

시계추가 이리저리 흔들렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 둔하고 무거운 소리를 내며. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 매시 정각에. <break time="0.8s" /> 시계는 깊고 이상한 소리로 울렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 소리는 너무 크고 이상했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 악사들은 연주를 멈춰야 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 춤추던 사람들도 춤을 멈추었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 잠시 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 즐겁던 무리 전체가 불안해졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 가장 들떠 있던 손님들조차 창백해졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나이 든 손님들은 손으로 쓸었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자기 이마를. <break time="0.8s" /> 마치 길을 잃은 것처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 어지러운 꿈속에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 메아리가 잦아들자. <break time="0.8s" /> 가벼운 웃음이 방마다 퍼졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 악사들은 웃었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자신들이 긴장했던 것을 두고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 속삭이며 다짐했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그렇게 불안해하지 않겠다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음번에 시계가 울릴 때에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러나 60분이 지나자. <break time="0.8s" /> 즉 3, 600초가 지나자. <break time="0.8s" /> 시계가 다시 울렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 모두가 불안해했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 전과 똑같이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래도 파티는 활기찼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 왜냐하면 공은 화려한 색을 좋아했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 기이한 효과도. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 모든 장식을 직접 계획했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어떤 사람들은 생각했을지도 모른다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 미쳤다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그를 따르는 사람들은 확신했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 미치지 않았다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 손님들은 기괴한 의상을 입었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 일곱 개의 방을 누볐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 꿈속의 형상들처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 시계가 다시 한 번 울릴 때까지.
